status: theory specification frozen before numerical enjoyment joins; fixture failures may cause versioned amendments
target: learnable nonliteral variation, not universal musical quality

api.events: list of dictionaries {tick: integer, pitch: integer, channel: integer}; ticks use traversed tracker speed clock, BPM ignored
api.output: JSON serializable dictionary with method_id, eligibility, limitations, invariants, feature_hash, predictive, variation, cycle, geometry, candidates

canonicalization.time_origin: subtract first eligible onset tick from every event and total_ticks; total_ticks is exclusive end of traversed authored timeline
canonicalization.time_unit: one tracker tick; 24 ticks per conventional musical beat; row advances by active speed; speed effects applied on same row as native engine
canonicalization.exact_events: merge events at identical tick into SET of pitch classes pitch modulo 12; discard channel, instrument, amplitude and duplicate pitch classes
canonicalization.pitch_sequence: bitmask at each distinct nonempty onset tick; K=4096
canonicalization.ioi_sequence: consecutive positive onset gaps; token=min(gap,385); K=386; overflow fraction reported
canonicalization.seed_policy: same fixed seed for all sources; never seed on raw XM bytes; deterministic event and phase ordering
canonicalization.eligibility: no onsets => all candidate scalars null; fewer than 32 distinct onset times => predictive eligibility false, candidates null; fewer than two nonempty windows at all variation settings => candidates null

predictive.pk: (previous_count(context,symbol)+p0)/(previous_count(context)+1); if t<k use p0; only update context models with full k-symbol history
predictive.mixture: Bayesian sequence mixture; initial weight 1/5; predict sum_k weight_k*pk then weight_k *= pk/p_mixture, in log domain
predictive.loss: negative sum log2(probability), scored before current event updates
predictive.pitch_null: independently permute pitch-set labels among onset indices within equal (tick modulo 24) groups; preserve timestamps, phase-conditioned marginals and polyphony cardinality distribution within phase
predictive.ioi_null: permute IOI tokens globally; preserve their empirical marginal
predictive.null_interpretation: effect-size correction only, not a calibrated p-value; eight draws insufficient for conventional small significance levels

variation.window: nonoverlapping complete windows from offset to exclusive total_ticks; omit empty windows and report their fraction; fingerprint sorted (relative_tick,pitch_set_bitmask)
variation.aggregate: V=mean of non-null settings; report setting count and all four values

short_cycle_guard.exact_definition: find smallest integer p in 1..384 such that total_ticks is divisible by p, total_ticks/p>=3, and canonical sparse onset-mask map exactly tiles p over total_ticks; no approximate or partial-tail matches
short_cycle_guard.guard: G=0 if such p exists; G=1 otherwise
short_cycle_guard.scope: rejects exact short complete cycles only; intro, tail, longer cycle or one changed event can defeat this guard

geometry.name: onset_pitch_set_transport_organization
geometry.mass: uniform probability on distinct pitch classes at each onset
geometry.transport: minimum mass-weighted cost between successive onset sets; equal and unequal cardinalities allowed; use exact circular one-dimensional Wasserstein or linear programming and memoize ordered mask pairs
geometry.circular_formula: for 12-bin probability vectors u,v, let f_j=sum_{k=0}^j(u_k-v_k); W=(sum_j abs(f_j-median(f)))/6
geometry.actual: mean W over adjacent onset sets; no last-to-first seam unless separately reported
geometry.null: same eight phase-conditioned pitch-label permutations as predictive pitch test
geometry.interpretation: ordered pitch geometry relative to phase-conditioned reorderings; not realized voice leading, consonance, tonal function, or perceptual harmony

candidates.selection: C1 remains primary even if C2 correlates better in exploratory full-data analysis; any selected candidate needs untouched grouped holdout

required_fixtures: channel layouts8/10/16/20 with fixed musical content: exact equality
permutation, empty channel padding, unison and octave doubling, equivalent track split/merge: exact equality
132 versus131.999 BPM externally represented: exact equality; XM BPM integer limitation recorded
double row resolution with half speed and same musical event times: exact equality
constant global transposition: equality to floating tolerance with identical surrogate index permutations
pure complete short loop>=3 repeats: C1=C2=0
fixed-length random and marginal-matched shuffles: predictive gain low in ensemble, no universal single-seed ordering claim
theme variation, random suffix, loop plus random insertions, independent patterned carrier plus noise: adversarial diagnostics
geometric adjacent-semitone progression versus shuffled order: transport test responds in expected direction
constant chromatic aggregate: geometry0/null, expose loss of melodic voice information
monophonic case: geometry interpreted as melodic step economy
all missing or unsupported extraction states retained as explicit ineligible rows
